findings.text: `int(nth)` silently truncates or wraps large values of the generic integer type N. For example, `Nth(s, uint64(math.MaxUint64))` becomes n=-1 and returns the last element instead of an out-of-bounds error. On 32-bit builds, `int64(1<<32)` becomes 0 and returns the first element. The bounds check should run on the original type, or the conversion should be range-checked.
